items.title: Disney Keeps Cheapest Tickets Flat as Add-On Prices Climb
items.snippet: Skift Take: Lower priced tickets can help build loyal visitors while premium add-ons drive more spending at the parks. Disney’s latest round of price hikes targets premium add-ons while keeping lower-tier tickets stable, part of Disney’s bet that budget-conscious first-timers will become bigger spenders down the line.

items.title: Marriott Sees Local Cuisine Driving Asia Pacific F&B Trends
items.snippet: 95% of surveyed properties identify authentic local dishes as the region’s strongest dining trend Local cuisine is emerging as the strongest force shaping food and beverage trends across Asia Pacific excluding China, with 95% of Marriott International’s surveyed properties identifying demand for authentic local signature dishes as the biggest trend in their markets.

items.title: How Flanigan's Resort & Spa Boosted Ancillary Revenue by 57% With Canary's GMS
items.snippet: Flanigan's Resort & Spa near Zion National Park achieved a 57% ancillary revenue uplift in its first year using Canary's GMS, with mobile check-in, digital upsells, and smart checkout cutting front desk friction.

items.title: EL AL Hotel Platform Records 35,000 Nights in First Month
items.snippet: Airline’s Arbitrip-powered platform sees 130 million loyalty points redeemed for hotel stays EL AL Airlines’ hotel booking platform, powered by travel technology company Arbitrip, recorded more than 35,000 hotel nights booked in its first month , while customers redeemed more than 130 million frequent flyer points for hotel stays.

items.title: Fairmont enters Greece with a resort in Crete
items.snippet: Accor announced on 24 September the signing of the Fairmont Chania Resort, in Chania, on the north-west coast of Crete. The project is being carried out with Hersonissos Group Hotels. The resort comprises 104 keys and is due to open in 2029. It will be the Fairmont brand's first address in Greece.

items.title: Hyatt updates Hyatt Place, Hyatt Studios prototypes
items.snippet: Hyatt reduced key counts for both models, along with other changes, as it aims to “improve development economics” for owners. To create a “more efficient new-build model intended to improve profitability and return on investment,” Hyatt has reduced the key count on the Hyatt Place prototype from 140 to 127, per the release. The move decreases the overall building area by nearly 20%.

items.title: Sri Lanka: An Island of Opportunities
items.snippet: Sri Lanka: An Island of Opportunities by Hotelivate | Oct 7, 2026 Sri Lanka has long been one of Asia’s most distinctive tourism destinations. Few markets offer the same combination of beaches, wildlife, mountains, culture and religious heritage within such a compact geography. This diversity has helped the country attract a broad range of travellers and made tourism an important contributor to the national economy.

items.title: The Dough Therapy secures Rs 5.25 crore seed funding at Rs 35 crore valuation, sets sight on rapid expansion
BeKind Hotels and Resorts introduces Diwali experiences at Meyyafushi and Fushifaru Maldives
items.snippet: BeKind Hotels and Resorts has introduced a series of Diwali experiences at Meyyafushi Maldives and Fushifaru Maldives, offering Indian travellers festive dining and private celebrations across its island resorts. At Meyyafushi Maldives, guests will have the option to exclusively hire a secluded sandbank for a private Diwali celebration with family and friends.

items.title: TAFI@40: Indian travel trade come together in Greece for landmark Convention
items.snippet: Indian travel trade leaders converged in Greece on Rhodes Island as the Travel Agents Federation of India (TAFI) marked its 40th anniversary with its landmark Convention, putting destination engagement, trade networking and stronger India-Greece tourism ties at the centre of discussions.
